features: Reads the Windows DNS server: zones with their settings, forwarders, conditional forwarders, aging and scavenging every 15 minutes, and the records of one zone on request.
Changes the DNS server from the portal: zones, zone settings, records (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, PTR, TXT, SRV, NS), forwarders, conditional forwarders, scavenging and the cache.
Runs only under agent 4.20.0 or later, talks only to the local DNS server and has no network access of its own.
